original_idea.body: # Werewolf/Mafia Social-Deduction Deception Arena. Minimal game engine where open models deceive; tag truth/lie against ground-truth roles; measure deception success and CoT leakage.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Deception-skill/CoT-leakage testbed useful but link to catastrophic risk has a gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Minimal game engine + truth/lie tagging; some agent-harness engineering, mentor helps.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused arena with clear metrics; building the engine is moderate effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Self-contained deception testbed, ground-truth labels; independent-friendly.

low_compute.reasoning: Multi-agent inference, several games; single GPU/API.

novelty.reasoning: WOLF already establishes the Werewolf-deception paradigm; this largely overlaps.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: WOLF establishes the paradigm; CoT-leakage angle is incremental.
